description: Run a k6 test script with configurable parameters. Returns execution results including stdout, stderr, exit code, and raw metrics from k6.

duration.description: Test duration (max: '5m'). When omitted, script-defined options and k6 defaults are used. Examples: '30s', '2m', '5m'. Overridden by iterations if specified.

iterations.description: Number of iterations per VU (overrides duration). Examples: 1 for single run, 100 for throughput test.

script.description: The k6 script content to run (JavaScript/TypeScript). Should be a valid k6 script with proper imports and default function.

vus.description: Number of virtual users. When omitted, script-defined options and k6 defaults are used. Examples: 1 for basic test, 10 for moderate load, 100 for stress test.

name: run_script
